title: Longhorn PHP 2021 - CFP Open
content:
Howdy, y'all! 🤠

is returning for its 3rd year in Austin, TX! We are a community-run conference for PHP developers in Texas and beyond. We are excited to bring PHP developers from all backgrounds together again for 3 days of fun and education.Longhorn PHP

We are currently accepting submissions for 50 minute talks and 3 hour tutorials. Talk ideas will be accepted until June 30, 2021.

While the CFP is open, we also have our Blind Bird tickets available for sale. Register now!
